# Coverage matrix

<!-- Generated by `gimp-mcp coverage --inventory docs/coverage/pdb-inventory.json --output docs/coverage.md`. Do not edit by hand: edit `src/gimp_mcp/coverage.py`. -->

Inventory: GIMP **3.2.6**, 1030 PDB procedures (722 internal, 3 persistent, 244 plugin, 61 temporary), 200 GEGL operations available to filters.

MCP tools: **32**. PDB procedures relied upon by tools: **69** (6.7% of the inventory). Most PDB procedures are low-level getters/setters, so this percentage measures breadth, not usefulness.

## Capabilities

| Area | Capability | Status | MCP tools | Verified by | Min. GIMP | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Session | Connection diagnostics, open images | tested | `gimp_status` | `tests/e2e/test_connection.py`, `tests/e2e/test_lifecycle.py`, `tests/e2e/test_restart.py` | 3.2 |  |
| Inspection | Image properties and ordered layer tree (groups, masks) | tested | `gimp_inspect_image`, `gimp_inspect_item` | `tests/e2e/test_inspect.py` | 3.2 |  |
| Preview | Composite preview as PNG (max 1024 px) | tested | `gimp_preview` | `tests/e2e/test_preview.py` | 3.2 | 8-bit sRGB rendering of the visible layers; larger renders go through export. |
| Files | Create, open, save XCF, export PNG/JPEG, close | tested | `gimp_create_image`, `gimp_open_image`, `gimp_save_image`, `gimp_export_image`, `gimp_close_image` | `tests/e2e/test_files.py` | 3.2 | Other export formats (WebP, TIFF, PSD...) are reachable in the PDB but not exposed. |
| Layers | Create, group, import, duplicate, rename, reorder, delete layers; visibility, opacity, mode, locks | tested | `gimp_create_layer`, `gimp_create_group`, `gimp_import_layer`, `gimp_duplicate_layer`, `gimp_set_layer_properties`, `gimp_move_layer`, `gimp_delete_layer` | `tests/e2e/test_layers.py` | 3.2 |  |
| Geometry | Scale/resize canvas/crop images; move, scale, rotate, flip layers | tested | `gimp_resize_image`, `gimp_resize_canvas`, `gimp_crop_image`, `gimp_set_layer_offsets`, `gimp_scale_layer`, `gimp_rotate_layer`, `gimp_flip_layer` | `tests/e2e/test_transform.py` | 3.2 | Perspective, shear and arbitrary matrices are not exposed. |
| Discovery | Search and describe PDB procedures (read-only) | tested | `gimp_search_procedures`, `gimp_describe_procedure` | `tests/e2e/test_procedures.py` | 3.2 | Introspection only; nothing is executed. |
| History | Undo / redo from a client | unsupported | — | — | 3.2 | GIMP 3.2 offers no undo/redo procedure to plug-ins (only undo groups); see #9. |
| Painting | Fill and stroke with explicit parameters | unsupported | — | — | 3.2 | Planned: #11. |
| Selections | Rectangle/ellipse selections (replace/add/subtract/intersect), all/none/invert, bounds; layer masks | tested | `gimp_select_rectangle`, `gimp_select_ellipse`, `gimp_modify_selection`, `gimp_get_selection`, `gimp_add_layer_mask`, `gimp_set_layer_mask`, `gimp_remove_layer_mask` | `tests/e2e/test_selections.py` | 3.2 | Free/fuzzy/by-color selections, paths and channels are not exposed. |
| Filters | Color corrections and filters | unsupported | — | — | 3.2 | Planned: #13. |
| Text | Editable text layers | unsupported | — | — | 3.2 | Planned: #14. |
| Generic PDB | Calling allowed PDB procedures | unsupported | — | — | 3.2 | Planned: #16. |
| Other | Paths/vectors, channels, guides, color mode conversion, indexed images, animation | unsupported | — | — | 3.2 | Not planned yet. |

## Regenerating

```sh
uv run gimp-mcp inventory --output docs/coverage/pdb-inventory.json   # needs a running GIMP
uv run gimp-mcp coverage --inventory docs/coverage/pdb-inventory.json --output docs/coverage.md
```
